name: application-step-indicator-dots
title: Step Indicator Dots
description: Minimal dot and numbered-circle progress indicator components for short multi-step flows.
useWhen: Minimal dot and numbered-circle progress indicator components for short multi-step flows.
avoidWhen: Avoid step indicator dots when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Step Indicator Dots uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
